verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents full native ClickHouse protocol and SQL compatibility, plain MergeTree DDL, and working s3()/url() table functions, so data and schema stay in a portable, standard ClickHouse form that any ClickHouse client or tool can read. However, the docs only describe migration onto ObsessionDB and ingestion; they never describe exporting data out or offboarding. missing for 10: explicit documented export to open formats (e.g., Parquet/CSV to object storage), a documented exit or offboarding path, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full data export.
